headline: Caplin Point Laboratories files SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure (Reg 31(4))
sum: Caplin Point Laboratories has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) of the Takeover Regulations 2011, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or control event, but acquirer identity and deal terms remain undisclosed in publicly available sources as of the filing date.
detail: Caplin Point Laboratories Limited submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 16 June 2026. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure by a target company when the acquirer crosses a 5% shareholding threshold or announces an open offer. The substance of this acquisition — including the buyer's identity, consideration, number of shares, and timeline — is not yet publicly detailed in accessible sources.
